provenance: forager fetch --all-wheels pkg:pypi/etg-heroku@0.2.0 recovered the exact supplied SHA-256; artifact and .forage.json retained in scratch.
static_trace: Python package __init__ only exposes runtime and artifact paths; it does not load the native library on import.
ELF AArch64 hso_write_blob at 0x2950 opens a caller-supplied path in wb mode and writes the supplied array/length; exported wrappers select the ZIP and Python helper arrays.

hhr_start at 0x2a58 splits caller argv on 0x1f, calls forkpty at 0x2d64, then chdir/setenv/execvp in the child. Parent retains the PTY descriptor; hhr_read/write/resize/stop operate on it. No socket control channel is present in this native path.
ELF contains a ZIP ending at file offset 0x1baa84 and a plaintext plugin at 0x1baaa0. Recovered 136 ZIP members and the 122087-byte plugin without executing either.
Plugin _start_runtime invokes Python -u -m heroku through hhr_start, or imports the runtime in a thread; provides visible Start/Stop/Restart/console controls. auto_start defaults false.
Plugin installs bundled Android wheels first; x0.at download overrides are fallback URLs for Android builds of pydantic-core, orjson and psutil. BDIG.whl declares psutil 7.1.3.
Recovered userbot dispatcher calls security.check before dispatch. DEFAULT_PERMISSIONS is OWNER. Terminal module exposes user-requested shell commands and returns output through the userbot.

Balance of evidence supports the declared Android userbot hosting purpose. No unauthorized collection, attacker-selected controller, or malicious deployment context was established. Actual installation authorization and complete upstream provenance of every bundled dependency remain unknown.
